description: This file defines a class for validating FTP URI schemes in the context of HTML purification, implementing specific URI validation logic according to RFC 1738.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_ftp
classes.description: A class representing FTP URI scheme with validation logic, extending the base URIScheme class.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and processes the provided FTP URI according to custom rules, including handling of type declarations in the URI path.
